messages:
kelly: seeing a subtle preview bump tied to resolver-canary at ~11:03 UTC, about 0.2% across many small tenants. tagging routing owners.
pablo: same. correlates with sticky-resolve=true change rolled at 11:01 (ingest-bot shows deploy). not massive but consistent.
ingest-bot: deploy 1823456779 to resolver-service-canary succeeded at 11:01 UTC (user: pablo).
mira: quick hypothesis: sticky-resolve avoids re-resolving mid-session, but if a refresh still emits a transient alias flip we could be double-emitting attribution (old+sticky). preview dedupe key is request_id only so flips cause duplicates.
kelly: can we temporarily freeze auto-apply for previews coming from resolver-canary? billing, can you hold?
billing: we can hold auto-apply for route_source=resolver-canary. need the tenant/time window export to scope credits.
pablo: flipping canary gate to 0% now to stop further spread.
ingest-bot: rollout gate for resolver-service-canary set to 0% by pablo at 11:06 UTC.
mira: mitigation plan: 1) pause rollout (done). 2) add consumer debounce: if two events with same fingerprint arrive within 8s, treat as single billing event. 3) run a one-off dedupe on preview window to produce corrections.
kelly: long-term: make metering contract require delivery_phase (early|final). only final increments billing. early_attrib stays telemetry. reduces races for sticky / optimistic behaviors.
billing: agreed. once you provide tenant list we'll run dry-run credits and then apply after signoff.
pablo: created ENGPLAT-8811 to track debounce + contract change + dedupe, assigned to pablo+mira. will attach tenant export shortly.
kelly: thanks. keep thread updates short and paste export to the ticket. :thumbsup:
